name: Sportlebore
description: A sportlebore hides amid the victuals on a plate of food or within a pack of trail rations.
disable: A creature that notices the sportlebore can remove it from the food it is hidden within automatically as an Interact action.

generalAbilities.name: Mimic Food
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature eats food the sportlebore is hidden within

Effect The sportlebore rapidly multiplies in the host's stomach, exposing the host to sportlebore infestation

generalAbilities.name: Sportlebore Infestation
generalAbilities.description:
Saving Throw Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 (1 hour)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 (1 hour)

Stage 4 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1
